components.label: Metric card
components.description: A compact KPI card with a label, a big value and a trend.
components.css: .lib-metric-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; width: 240px; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 14px; background: #111827; color: #e5e7eb; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.28); }

components.label: Profile card
components.description: Name, role and a small action row.
components.css: .lib-profile-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 260px; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 14px; background: #0f172a; color: #e5e7eb; }

components.label: Search bar
components.description: A search field with a submit button.
components.css: .lib-search-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 320px; padding: 8px; border: 1px solid #334155; border-radius: 12px; background: #0f172a; }

components.label: Status pill
components.css: .lib-status-pill { padding: 3px 10px; border: 1px solid #166534; border-radius: 999px; background: #052e16; color: #86efac; font-size: 12px; }
